title: Why Hospitals Panic Over One Blood Type
hook: One blood type is so rare hospitals can't always find a donor.
closing: Rare or common, your type matches someone, so your donation can matter.
question: Know your blood type? Drop it below.

segments.say: Only 1 percent of Americans have AB negative, the rarest type. Most common is O positive, at over a third.
Only 15 percent of Americans are Rh negative. That means a negative type is a small club, so fewer people share yours.
Over half of Latin American donors are O positive, but only about a third of Caucasian donors. Who gives shapes the mix.
